name: Badgers Stake
description: Stake BCH to earn BadgerCoins. Lock BCH in the BadgerStake contract for a number of blocks and earn one BadgerCoin per BCH per block; when the lock ends, the BCH, the BadgerCoins and a Honey NFT receipt go back to your address.

staker.name: Staker
staker.description: Locks BCH to earn BadgerCoins. Anyone can release a finished lock, but the payout always goes to the staker.

admin.name: Admin
admin.description: Holds the key whose hash is in the masterBadger commitment: collects the staking fees and sets the fee.

deploy.name: Deploy a masterBadger
deploy.description: Move a masterBadger (a minting NFT of category $(<badgerCategory>) carrying $(<masterTokenAmount>) BadgerCoins) into the BadgerStake contract, with a staking fee of $(<newStakeFee>) satoshis.

admin.name: Deploy
admin.description: Pick the minting NFT; it moves into the contract with your key hash as admin. Only the category in this template can be staked against.

stake.name: Stake BCH
stake.description: Lock $(<stakeSatoshis>) satoshis for $(<stakeBlocks>) blocks and earn $(stakeReward) BadgerCoins, paying a staking fee of $(stakeFee) satoshis.

staker.name: Stake
staker.description: Pick one plain BCH coin at a P2PKH address of yours (its key hash is your payout address), the amount to lock (at least 5000 sats) and the number of blocks (up to 32767). The reward is amount × blocks / 100,000,000.

unstake.name: Release a finished stake
unstake.description: Release a lock of $(<lockSatoshis>) satoshis after $(<stakeBlocks>) blocks: $(<lockTokenAmount>) BadgerCoins, a Honey NFT and the BCH (less 3000 sats) go to the staker’s address.

staker.name: Release
staker.description: Pick a lock whose period has passed. Anyone can release it; everything goes to the staker who made it.

withdraw.name: Withdraw staking fees
withdraw.description: Withdraw the masterBadger’s collected fees ($(<masterSatoshis>) satoshis, less 1000 kept and 1000 fee) and set the staking fee to $(<newStakeFee>) satoshis.

admin.name: Withdraw
admin.description: Pick one plain BCH coin at the admin address named in the masterBadger commitment, and where the fees go.

deployTransaction.name: masterBadger deployed
deployTransaction.description: A masterBadger with $(<masterTokenAmount>) BadgerCoins moved into the BadgerStake contract.

stakeTransaction.name: BCH staked
stakeTransaction.description: $(<stakeSatoshis>) satoshis locked for $(<stakeBlocks>) blocks, earning $(stakeReward) BadgerCoins.

unstakeTransaction.name: Stake released
unstakeTransaction.description: $(<lockTokenAmount>) BadgerCoins, a Honey NFT and the locked BCH were released to the staker.

withdrawTransaction.name: Staking fees withdrawn
withdrawTransaction.description: The masterBadger’s fees were withdrawn and the staking fee set to $(<newStakeFee>) satoshis.

stakerCoinInput.name: Your coin
stakerCoinInput.description: A plain BCH coin at the P2PKH address of $(<stakerPublicKeyHash>), at input 1. It pays the stake, the fee and the miner; the rest comes back.

lockInput.name: Stake lock
lockInput.description: A lock whose $(<stakeBlocks>) blocks have passed.

adminCoinInput.name: Admin coin
adminCoinInput.description: A plain BCH coin at the admin address in the masterBadger commitment, at input 1. Its signature authorises the withdrawal.

masterDeployOutput.name: masterBadger
masterDeployOutput.description: The masterBadger in the BadgerStake contract, holding $(<masterTokenAmount>) BadgerCoins.

masterAfterStakeOutput.name: masterBadger (after the stake)
masterAfterStakeOutput.description: The masterBadger with the staking fee added and the reward taken out.

lockOutput.name: Stake lock
lockOutput.description: $(<stakeSatoshis>) satoshis and $(stakeReward) BadgerCoins locked for $(<stakeBlocks>) blocks.

stakeChangeOutput.name: Change
stakeChangeOutput.description: What is left of your coin, back to the same address.

honeyOutput.name: Honey NFT
honeyOutput.description: A receipt NFT recording the $(<lockTokenAmount>) BadgerCoins earned.

unstakedOutput.name: Released BCH
unstakedOutput.description: The staked BCH, less 3000 satoshis for the two token outputs and the fee.

masterAfterWithdrawOutput.name: masterBadger (after the withdrawal)
masterAfterWithdrawOutput.description: The masterBadger, left with 1000 satoshis and the new staking fee.

withdrawOutput.name: Withdrawn fees
withdrawOutput.description: The masterBadger’s collected fees plus the admin coin, less 2000 satoshis.

badgerLockingScript.name: BadgerStake
badgerLockingScript.description: The BadgerStake contract, holding the masterBadger and every stake lock.

stakerLockingScript.name: Staker address
stakerLockingScript.description: The staker’s P2PKH address. The contract sends change and payouts here, and only here.

badgerCategory.name: masterBadger category
badgerCategory.description: The BadgerCoin token category the contract hard-codes (badgers.cash on mainnet), for the token fields. It must match the bytecode.

satoshisPerCoin.name: Satoshis per coin
satoshisPerCoin.description: One BadgerCoin per 100,000,000 satoshis per block.

minimumStakeSatoshis.name: Minimum stake
minimumStakeSatoshis.description: The smallest amount the contract lets you lock.

maximumStakeBlocks.name: Maximum stake period
maximumStakeBlocks.description: The longest lock that works: 32767 blocks. The contract allows 65536, but stores the period in 2 bytes, which fails above 32767.

maximumStakeFee.name: Maximum staking fee
maximumStakeFee.description: The largest fee a 2-byte commitment field holds as a positive number.

payoutDustSatoshis.name: Payout token dust
payoutDustSatoshis.description: Satoshis the contract puts on each payout token output.

unstakeCostSatoshis.name: Release cost
unstakeCostSatoshis.description: Taken from the staked BCH on release: two 1000-sat token outputs and a 1000-sat fee.

masterDustSatoshis.name: masterBadger dust
masterDustSatoshis.description: Satoshis left on the masterBadger after a withdrawal.

withdrawCostSatoshis.name: Withdrawal cost
withdrawCostSatoshis.description: Kept back on a withdrawal: 1000 sats left on the masterBadger and a 1000-sat fee.

stakeMinerFeeSatoshis.name: Stake fee to miners
stakeMinerFeeSatoshis.description: The miner fee of a stake transaction (about 2 sats per byte of its ~860 bytes).

changeDustSatoshis.name: Change dust limit
changeDustSatoshis.description: The smallest change a stake may return (the P2PKH dust limit).

masterSatoshis.name: masterBadger satoshis
masterSatoshis.description: The satoshis on the masterBadger now (or, when deploying, to put on it).

masterTokenAmount.name: masterBadger BadgerCoins
masterTokenAmount.description: The BadgerCoins the masterBadger holds now.

masterCommitment.name: masterBadger commitment
masterCommitment.description: The masterBadger’s 40-byte commitment, as hex: the staking fee (2 bytes), padding (18 bytes) and the admin key hash (20 bytes).

stakeBlocks.name: Lock period
stakeBlocks.description: Blocks the stake stays locked, from 1 to 32767.

stakerPublicKeyHash.name: Your key hash
stakerPublicKeyHash.description: The 20-byte public key hash of the P2PKH address your coin is at, as hex. Payouts go back to it.

stakerCoinSatoshis.name: Your coin’s value
stakerCoinSatoshis.description: The value in satoshis of the coin you stake from.

lockSatoshis.name: Lock satoshis
lockSatoshis.description: The satoshis in the lock being released.

newStakeFee.name: Staking fee
newStakeFee.description: The fee in satoshis each stake pays the masterBadger, from 0 to 32767.

adminPublicKeyHash.name: Admin key hash
adminPublicKeyHash.description: The 20-byte public key hash of the admin’s P2PKH address, as hex.

adminCoinSatoshis.name: Admin coin value
adminCoinSatoshis.description: The value in satoshis of the admin coin used to authorise the withdrawal.

withdrawLockingScript.name: Withdraw to
withdrawLockingScript.description: The locking script that receives the withdrawn fees.

resources.name: Original BadgerStake contract
resources.description: BadgerStake.cash by SayoshiNakamario, compiled with cashc 0.10.0-next.4. This template uses it unchanged. The repository has no licence file.

resources.name: Template, artifact and tests
resources.description: This template, the rebuilt artifact and the tests that tie it to the live contract.
